title: Mohd. Shahjad v. U.P. Power Corpn. Ltd.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Vijay Manohar Sahai, J.; Raj Mani Chauhan, J.
disposition: Recovery on 4.3.2010 assessment stayed until further orders.
headnote: Division Bench granted an interlocutory stay of recovery on a 4 March 2010 theft assessment. The petitioner showed a police final report that theft was not established, withdrawal of the criminal case, and a Supply Code paragraph 8(1)(b)(iv) bar to final assessment. The Court found force in that contention and stayed recovery pending the writ.
facts: Mohd. Shahjad faced an FIR for theft of electricity. Police submitted a final report that theft was not established. He challenged an order in criminal revision. U.P. Power Corporation Ltd. later withdrew the criminal proceedings and proceeded to final assessment for the alleged theft. Recovery was sought under an order dated 4 March 2010. He contended that, theft not having been established, final assessment was barred by paragraph 8(1)(b)(iv) of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

holding_units.topic: final assessment for theft after police final report
holding_units.holding: Prima facie, final assessment for theft of electricity cannot proceed where theft was not established (police final report; criminal proceedings withdrawn), in view of paragraph 8(1)(b)(iv) of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005; recovery on the 4 March 2010 assessment is stayed until further orders.
holding_units.flag: Order cites paragraph no.8(1)(b)(iv) without quoting the clause; numbering taken as written.

not_decided.point: Whether paragraph 8(1)(b)(iv) finally bars assessment after a police final report and withdrawal of the criminal case
not_decided.note: Only an interlocutory stay; writ remains pending.
